detail.longDescription:
Manus is a general AI agent that turns ideas into finished work. It doesn't just answer; it plans, builds and delivers. Make AI videos, slides, docs, websites, apps and games from one prompt, connect your favorite tools, and even control your computer from your phone.

From Idea to Execution
Manus breaks your task into steps, runs them on its own computer in the cloud and delivers the result. Close the app and Manus keeps working; you get a notification when it is done. Stop or edit your request at any time.

AI Video Generator: One Prompt, One Finished Video
Describe a video in one sentence. Manus researches the idea, writes the script and storyboard, generates every shot with leading video models such as Seedance 2.5, then adds voiceover, music, captions and sound effects. Text to video, image to video, or start from your own footage and product photos.

Video Editor
Your result is an editable project, not a flat file. Keep refining by chat, or open the Video Editor in Manus on desktop to trim clips, swap the music, drop in your own footage and fine-tune every track on a timeline. No editing experience needed.

Videos for Business and Social
Create product ads, launch films, AI UGC videos, explainers, tutorials, promo videos, game trailers, music videos, vlogs and vertical short videos for social media. Connect your brand docs so every video fits your product, tone and audience.

AI Slides and Presentations
Turn a prompt or a file into a complete slide deck in minutes: pitch decks, reports, lessons and business presentations. Export to PPT or PDF and share with your team.

Docs, Sheets and PDFs
Write and edit documents, analyze spreadsheets, summarize PDFs and turn research into clear reports. Wide Research runs many agents in parallel for large research tasks.

AI Website Builder
Build a full website from one prompt: landing pages, online stores, portfolios, booking sites and web apps with login, database and payments. Connect your own domain, track visitors and collect leads. No coding needed.

AI App Builder
Describe your app idea and Manus builds a working mobile app for iOS and Android, with frontend, backend and database. Preview it on your phone, keep improving it in chat, and publish it to Google Play.

AI Game Maker
Make your own game without coding. Describe the gameplay, world and art style, and Manus builds a playable game with rules, art and sound: platformers, puzzle games, racing games, arcade games and 3D games. Play it, test it and ask for changes to levels, controls or difficulty. Publish your game as a link anyone can play in the browser, and invite friends to multiplayer games.

Connectors
Connect Manus to the apps you already use, including Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Outlook, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Shopify, Canva and HubSpot. Add a custom MCP server or an API key for anything else. Manus reads your context and takes action across your tools.

Remote Control and Computer Use
Control your computer or a cloud computer from your phone. Ask Manus to find a file, run an app or finish a task on your desktop, and watch it work live. Manus only uses the files, browser and apps you approve, and you stay in control.

Automations
Let work run on its own. Schedule tasks, or start a workflow when something happens: a new email, a calendar event, a Slack message or a Notion update. Add a cloud computer for projects that need to run 24/7.

Free AI Chat
Ask anything and get instant answers. Switch to Agent mode when you need Manus to do the work.
